description: This file defines a Sandbox widget for the Kivy framework, including classes for managing exception handling within a sandboxed environment, and a test application demonstrating its usage.

classes.name: SandboxExceptionManager
classes.description: Custom exception manager that handles exceptions within the Sandbox, delegating to the sandbox's on_exception method.

classes.name: SandboxContent
classes.description: A simple RelativeLayout subclass used as the container for sandboxed widgets.

classes.name: Sandbox
classes.description: Main widget class that creates a sandboxed environment, manages exception handling, and schedules sandbox clock updates.

classes.name: TestButton
classes.description: A test Button subclass used in the demonstration, with overridden touch event methods.

methods.name: sandbox
methods.description: Decorator that wraps functions to execute within the sandbox context.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for SandboxExceptionManager, initializes with a sandbox reference.

methods.name: handle_exception
methods.description: Handles exceptions, passing them to the sandbox's on_exception method.

methods.name: on_context_created
methods.description: Placeholder method for subclasses to override for custom context setup.

methods.name: on_exception
methods.description: Method to handle exceptions; prints traceback and returns True to suppress re-raising.

methods.name: add_widget
methods.description: Adds a widget to the sandbox container, wrapped with the sandbox decorator.

methods.name: remove_widget
methods.description: Removes a widget from the sandbox container, wrapped with the sandbox decorator.

methods.name: clear_widgets
methods.description: Clears all widgets from the sandbox container, wrapped with the sandbox decorator.

methods.name: on_size
methods.description: Updates container size on size change, wrapped with the sandbox decorator.

methods.name: on_pos
methods.description: Updates container position on position change, wrapped with the sandbox decorator.

methods.name: _clock_sandbox
methods.description: Scheduled method to update the sandbox clock and sync builder.

methods.name: _clock_sandbox_draw
methods.description: Scheduled method to update the drawing clock and trigger redraw.
